Among the many intriguing matchups feature Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics against Jalen Brunson and the defending champion New York Knicks, as well as Kevin Durant and the Houston Rockets against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs. Among the other top options for NBA DFS lineups include Cade Cunningham, Luka Doncic, Cooper Flagg, Tyrese Haliburton, LeMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Paul George, Kawhi Leonard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Karl-Anthony Towns, Bam Adebayo and Paolo Banchero.
 Doncic is the most expensive player on both DraftKings and FanDuel as the Lakers battle the Clippers. Knowing which players justify their high costs and knowing which are better kept our of daily Fantasy basketball lineups should be a part of your NBA DFS strategy.
 Before making any NBA DFS picks on sites like DraftKings and FanDuel for this slate, you need to see what Mike McClure has to say.
 McClure is a DFS professional with over $2 million in career winnings . He's also a predictive data engineer at SportsLine who uses a powerful prediction model that simulates every minute of every game 10,000 times, taking factors like matchups, statistical trends and injuries into account.
 This allows him to find the best NBA DFS values and create optimal lineups that he shares only at SportsLine. They're a must-see for any NBA DFS player.
 For Friday, one of McClure's top NBA DFS picks is Wizards forward Anthony Davis ($8,600 on DraftKings, $10,400 on FanDuel). He's also building around Pacers power forward Obi Toppin ($4,500 on DraftKings, $4,300 on FanDuel). The former No. 8 overall pick in the 2020 NBA Draft posted career highs in points (11.6), rebounds (4.4) and assists (2.3) last season, in addition to 0.5 steals.
